observations.videoLimitations: Actual browser JPEG screenshots encoded at 15fps. Encoded FPS is not a browser rendering-performance measurement. Mobile swipe is a labeled synthetic touch sequence.

limitations: Focused Chromium/WebKit surface-opening checks. Mobile swipe and document visibility are synthetic event integration; pointer/viewport emulation is not a physical device. Direct-file visits do not include route-local animation instrumentation. No full-page or native Simulator rerun.
